name: Kodak Professional T-MAX P3200 (3200TMZ)
notes: Multi-speed film: the sheet's nominal speed is EI 1000 in T-MAX / T-MAX RS developer and EI 800 in other Kodak developers ('rounded to EI 800'); the name P3200 refers to the push range. iso is the rated EI 800 of the curves; the sheet lists EI 400, 800, 1600, 3200, 6400 (and 12500, 25000 in T-MAX, T-MAX RS, XTOL) with an adjusted development time for each.

Characteristic curves (page 8, scanned images, traced from hints; the plots say 'Exposure: Daylight'): x axis is absolute log exposure in lux-seconds, as printed; no Log H Ref is printed. The plots are labelled with development times only, not exposure indexes; the processing table (page 4) pairs each EI with a time, so the EI of a curve below is an inference from the time.

curves/v: T-MAX Developer, small tank, 20 C (68 F), 9 min. Same plot: v-tmax-8, v-tmax-11, v-tmax-13. For comparison the T-MAX small-tank times at 68 F in the processing table (page 4) are 8 1/2 min (EI 400), 9 1/2 (800), 10 1/2 (1600), 12 (3200), 13 1/2 (6400), 15 1/2 (12500).

Further plots: 'curves-tmaxrs' = T-MAX RS Developer and Replenisher, large tank, 20 C, 9/10/12/14/17 min (v-tmaxrs-9, -10, -12, -14, -17); 'curves-tmaxrotary' = T-MAX Developer, rotary tube, 20 C, 8/10/12/14 min (v-tmaxrot-8, -10, -12, -14). Which curve is which was taken from the order of the legend (shortest time = lowest curve) and the dash style.

The curves of a plot nearly coincide at the toe (log H below about -3.3, within about 0.03 density) and are traced as one ink line there; below that the lines of the same plot may differ only by a few hundredths of density.

Spectral sensitivity (page 7): effective exposure 1.4 s, Developer D-76 68 F (20 C), diffuse visual; sensitivity/v is the curve '1.0 greater than D-min', v-d03 the curve '0.3 greater than D-min'. Log sensitivity = reciprocal of exposure (ergs/cm2) as printed, axis from -1.0 (printed 1-bar.0) to 3.0. Both curves start at about 420 nm; they reach the bottom of the plot at about 670 nm (1.0) and 700 nm (0.3).

Grain: diffuse rms granularity 18, read at net diffuse density 1.00 with a 48 micrometre aperture, 12x, development in D-76 at 68 F (IMAGE STRUCTURE section). Resolving power 40 lines/mm (TOC 1.6:1) and 125 lines/mm (TOC 1000:1).

Push EIs on the sheet: 400/27, 800/30, 1600/33, 3200/36, 6400/39 (all developers listed: T-MAX, T-MAX RS, XTOL, XTOL 1:1, D-76, HC-110 B) and 12,500/42, 25,000/45 (T-MAX, T-MAX RS, XTOL, XTOL 1:1 only).
